problem.title: Delete Leaves with a Given Value
problem.problemStatement: Given the root of a binary tree and an integer X, repeatedly delete all leaf nodes having value X until no such leaf remains.
problem.input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The second line contains the node values. • The next N lines describe the binary tree. • The last line contains X.
